body: The vehicle map has pencil ticks at three stops. Grain caught in its fold matches the dark grain in the half empty bag.
title: The last feed run

body: Soap floats in green wash water. Two different work gloves are jammed into the same bucket after a field shift.
title: The shared wash bucket

body: This map bends along a farm road. The opened packet in its crease leaked only after the route crosses the fields.
title: The change of route

body: The tarp has a rectangle of untouched cloth where a crate stood. All around it lies the pale dust from the load.
title: The clean truck bed

body: The spoon is wrapped in newspaper dated before the road closures. Dark feed dust has settled inside the fold.
title: The spare feed scoop

body: A knotted rope divides the bags. The sack on one side has a green dust mark; those on the other are clean.
title: The split load

body: A bottle has dripped across the map where farm roads meet. Its cap is stained green and the map dries with the same halo.
title: The leaking water can

body: The shovel's handle has two different colored clays. The tarp wrapped around it has fresh tears shaped by a narrow truck bed.
title: The shifted field kit

body: A lunch pot is packed with feed dust instead of food. The clean fork inside it is still tied in paper.
title: The load carried home

body: This tire pump is streaked with the same pale dust as the sack cord. The clean tool roll beside them stayed shut.
title: The residue on the spare wheel
